description: S56 T8 (AL11): the agent door for narrowing autonomy — autonomy.proposeRevoke creates an INERT proposal row of kind autonomy_revoke (nothing is enforced or revoked until a person commits it at the socket's human door). The request carries no actor, createdBy, proposedBy, status, kind, state or conditions member (identity is stamped by the records service; the effect is fixed at revoke, so a smuggled state meets the service's strict decode). The answer is the stored row with THE copyable commit command and the fixed inertness note — the same PolicyProposeResult the policy twins answer with: one machinery, one sentence.
